data.text: Kate, I commit to choosing 10 tons this month under Luke’s proposed allocation. My family taught me to leave enough fish for the next catch, and keeping 50 tons in the lake protects all our livelihoods. Luke, thank you for the offer, but you shouldn’t have to sit out again—let’s plan on 10 tons each next month. John and Emma, can you confirm your 15 and 10 tons respectively so we have everyone’s agreement before fishing?
